WITH qc_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    count,
    CAST(count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM qc_counts) as share,
    (CAST(count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM qc_counts)) - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qc_counts)) as deviation
  FROM qc_counts
),
ranked_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    count,
    share,
    deviation,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC) as rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM with_metrics
),
threshold_value AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN (SELECT total_count FROM ranked_metrics LIMIT 1) < 10 
      THEN (SELECT MIN(deviation) FROM ranked_metrics)
      ELSE (SELECT deviation FROM ranked_metrics WHERE rn = 10)
    END as threshold
)
SELECT 
  arcref,
  count,
  share,
  deviation
FROM with_metrics
WHERE deviation >= (SELECT threshold FROM threshold_value)
ORDER BY deviation DESC

assumptions.assumption: arcref in scanqc is never NULL (enforced by NOT NULL schema constraint), so every QC record belongs to a project and deviation is always computable
When fewer than 10 projects exist, return all projects (since they all meet or exceed the minimum threshold). If 10+ projects exist, return the 10th-ranked project and all tied with it
